tools.purpose: Group RIP-relative global references in a PE by target and separate write sites from read sites, so the writer of an activation state word can be found instead of its readers.
tools.expect: one row per global with write/read counts and a single-writer / read-only / multi-writer verdict

notes: Read-only; x86-64 canonical RIP-relative forms only. A hit is a place to look, not a conclusion: confirm with a disassembler before writing a patch table.
